info.name: TTM for Jira Test Runs API
Create test runs from junit xml string.

items.docs:
## Import test run(s) (execution result) from JUnit XML string.
#### Body:
The body should be the XML content of the JUnit XML file.
#### Query parameters:
* **version** _(optional)_: Specify the version name which the test runs will be under.
* **cycleName** _(optional)_: cycle name to specify.
if not provided, it will take the it from the "name" attribute of the "testsuites" XML tag in case it exists.
if nothing provided, it will generate a name like "Junit execution (current date)".

params.name: limit
params.description: Numeric value that determines that maximum N results will be returned

params.name: offset
params.description: Numeric value that determines that the result list will start from result #N (zero based)
